name: Connected Devices and Making Minor
intro: The minor in Connected Devices and Making teaches undergraduate students how to design, develop and control electronic devices. With more and more connected devices gathering data both for industrial applications as well as to help inform consumer decisions, the opportunity for skills in this area has increased rapidly.
